description: This Python source file manages database configuration and session handling for a FastAPI application using SQLAlchemy and PostgreSQL. It includes functions to construct database URLs from environment variables, create and cache database engine and sessionmaker objects, and provide database sessions as dependencies for request handling.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for SQLAlchemy ORM models, inheriting from DeclarativeBase.

methods.name: str|None _env_first(*keys: str)
methods.description: Returns the first environment variable value found among provided keys.

methods.name: str _build_database_url()
methods.description: Constructs the database connection URL from environment variables, supporting both URL and component-based configurations.

methods.name: Engine _get_engine()
methods.description: Creates and memoizes the SQLAlchemy Engine with connection pooling.

methods.name: sessionmaker _get_sessionmaker()
methods.description: Creates and memoizes the SQLAlchemy sessionmaker bound to the engine.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] get_db()
methods.description: FastAPI dependency generator that yields a database session, handling errors related to environment config or connectivity issues.
